Name: Sam and Sebastian Expanded
Author: Krunkkus
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
An expansion mod that adds some new life and personality to Sam and Sebastian through new dialogue, schedule changes, animations, and events.

The mod currently adds over 40 new lines of dialogue for Sam, Sebastian, Jodi, Kent, Robin, Demetrius, Maru and Abigail, along with subtle romantic undertones between Sam and Sebastian that builds as your relationship with them grows.

This mod is still in its early stages, but I have plenty more planned for future updates.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Adds 40+ new lines of dialogue across Sam, Sebastian, Jodi, Kent , Robin, Demetrius, Maru and Abigail. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]New heart event. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Adds new smoking animation for Sam on Tuesdays, Saturdays and the Stardew Valley Fair. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]New Tuesday schedule for Sam. (Can be toggled on or off in the config file)[/color][/*]
[*]Removes Sebastian/Abigail romance and Sam/Penny romance by removing their schedules where they hang out certain days. [color=#d4d4d8](Can be toggled on or off in the config file)[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8][b][size=4]Content Warning[/size][/b]
This mod contains depictions of smoking and references to marijuana use. If you are not comfortable with those themes, this mod may not be for you.[/color]

[size=4][b]Heart Event Trigger[/b][/size]
[spoiler]Must have 2 hearts with both Sam and Sebastian, head to the Mountain between 10pm and 2am.[/spoiler]
[size=4][b]New Schedules[/b][/size]
[spoiler][size=4]Sam - Tuesdays - Spring, Summer and Winter[/size]

[b]10:00 AM - Leaves his room to go to Sebastian’s room.[/b]
[b]12:40 PM - Arrives in Sebastian's room.[/b]
[b]6:30 PM - Leaves with Sebastian and walks to lake.[/b]
[b]7:30 PM - Smoking at lake with Sebastian.[/b]
[b]9:30 PM - Heads home.
[/b][b]12:00 AM -  Arrives home and heads to bed. [/b]

[size=4]Sam - Tuesdays - Fall[/size]

[b]10:00 AM - Leaves his room to go to the mountain lake.[/b]
[b]1:00 PM - Arrives at mountain lake.[/b]
[b]2:00 PM - Follows Sebastian to the part of the lake outside the mines entrance.[/b]
[b]3:00 PM - Leaves the mines entrance and heads to the other side of the lake.[/b]
[b]3:30 PM - Smoking with Sebastian at the edge of the lake close to the bridge.[/b]
[b]4:00 PM - Heads to Sebastian’s room.[/b]
[b]7:30 PM - Starts heading home.[/b]
[b]10:00 PM - Arrives home and heads to bed.[/b][/spoiler]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]SMAPI[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Content Patcher[/color][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI [/*]
[*]Install Content Patcher [/*]
[*]Download this mod [/*]
[*]Extract zip file into: 
[code]Stardew Valley/mods[/code][/*]
[*]Launch game through SMAPI[/*]
[/list]To turn off the custom schedule changes edit the config.json to say 'False' instead of 'True'. [b](Warning:[/b] If you're using Generic Mod Config Menu to toggle this setting, do so from the main menu or at the VERY beginning or end of an in game day. Changing this setting mid active in-game day will cause scheduling bugs.)
